first.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) directly addresses the 6% QoQ activation decline and has proven to improve week-one engagement without retention risk. Onboarding simplification (memory_86) separately showed completion lift, but activation_messaging targets the immediate engagement gap more directly. Promotional pricing (memory_73) risks further retention damage despite competitive pressure—it's unsuitable here. Referral incentives work well for established customers but don't solve current activation weakness. Enterprise sales assist is orthogonal to the SMB activation problem. Verifying memory_86 and memory_73 confirms the relative safety of messaging vs. pricing in this context. A standard experiment on product-level activation messaging balances speed, learning, and risk given the primary objective of sustainable long-term revenue.
